title: ChatGPT Reached Users 15 Times Faster Than Instagram
hook: ChatGPT reached the same crowd 15 times faster than Instagram.
closing: Adoption speed made ChatGPT a mass habit before its business model caught up.
question: Do you use ChatGPT weekly?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million users. A chatbot became a mass-market habit at unprecedented scale.
ChatGPT reached the same crowd 15 times faster than Instagram. Adoption speed, not just size, broke the pattern.
ChatGPT has 850 million free users. The overwhelming majority use the service without paying.
